tasks.name: 创建博客数据库模型
tasks.description: 创建 BlogPost 和 Comment 数据库模型用于存储博客文章和评论。在 app/models/ 目录下创建 blog_post.py 和 comment.py，BlogPost 包含字段: id, title, description, image_url, created_at；Comment 包含字段: id, post_id, content, created_at。

tasks.name: 创建博客API
tasks.description: 创建博客文章和评论的 CRUD API 路由。在 app/routes/ 下创建 blog_posts.py 和 comments.py，blog_posts.py 包含创建、读取、更新、删除博客文章的接口；comments.py 包含添加和读取评论的接口。

tasks.name: 实现图片上传功能
tasks.description: 实现博客文章的图片上传功能。在 app/utils/ 下创建 image_upload.py，用于处理图片上传和存储逻辑；在 blog_posts.py API 中集成图片上传功能。

tasks.name: 创建博客前端页面
tasks.description: 创建博客文章和评论的前端页面。在 templates/ 下创建 blog.html，包含博客文章的展示、评论表单和评论列表；在 static/ 下创建样式文件 blog.css，设计明亮舒适的页面样式。

tasks.name: 集成前后端交互
tasks.description: 集成前端页面与后端 API 的交互。在 blog.html 中使用 JavaScript 或 AJAX 调用 blog_posts.py 和 comments.py 的 API，实现博客文章和评论的动态加载与提交。

T1.implementation_approach: Design a database schema with tables for users, blog posts, comments, and tags using an ORM like SQLAlchemy or Django ORM.
T1.notes: Ensure proper relationships and indexing for efficient querying.

T2.implementation_approach: Develop RESTful API endpoints for CRUD operations on blog posts, using a framework like Flask or Django REST Framework.
T2.notes: Include authentication and validation for secure access.

T3.implementation_approach: Implement a file upload endpoint to handle image uploads, store files in a directory or cloud storage, and save file paths in the database.
T3.notes: Validate file types and size to prevent misuse.

T4.implementation_approach: Create a responsive front-end using a framework like React or Vue.js, with pages for viewing, creating, and editing blog posts.
T4.notes: Focus on user-friendly design and mobile compatibility.

T5.implementation_approach: Use AJAX or fetch API to connect the front-end with the back-end API for dynamic data interaction.
T5.notes: Test thoroughly to ensure seamless communication between front-end and back-end.
